description:
CJ Hole are pleased to offer this City Centre apartment to the rental market, electricity included. Crusader House is a converted block of apartments on St Stephens Street in central Bristol. 

St Stephen Street is a short road linking the newly redesigned city centre with the popular runs of restaurant, cafes and bars on Corn Street.
The central location of the block allows residents a fantastic choice of shops and venues nearby to socialise by day and in the evening. 

For commuters, the area is also perfectly placed with many areas of employment within walking distance. For those requiring access out of the city, Bristol Temple Meads and Bristol Bus Station are just a short walk away.

Offered on an unfurnished basis.

EPC – D
Council Tax – B
Broadband ( Source OfCom ) – Standard, Superfast, Ultrafast
Mobile – ( Source Ofcom ) – Likely
